test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, D, L, X, Y and Z, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only five people sit between B and L. Z sits to the immediate left of L. Only one person sits between Z and D. A sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of X. Who sits third from the left end of the row?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, D, L, X, Y and Z, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only five people sit between B and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e0cfa52b8d46ba5365106774f4909ca807f2b508d4e76c85974af6a615dc757.png] 

Z sits to the immediate left of L. Only one person sits between Z and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a588852efcea44634f3442dc968e079e9488422fe2308e1fda8d63b8cefb0c0.png] 

 A sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2a8005d710d51aff9d71e1b3ee0adae93785b268e64015cab9c2bfd3491a882.png] 

Thus, A is the third from the left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
